Package be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.j2d

package be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.j2d
Java2D visualization and input layer.

J2dGame is the concrete GameView: it owns the window, the render pipeline, and game-world ↔ pixel coordinate conversion. J2dEntityFactory is the concrete Abstract Factory producing the visual entities in j2d.entities; InputHandler handles keyboard and mouse input; SpriteManager loads and caches sprite images. This package depends on the game logic, never the reverse.
